reviewed_bash_instructions.phase: Local public certificate metadata only; no socket/Secret/private key read
reviewed_bash_instructions.assumptions: DBA supplies exact absolute public certificate files via existing secure delivery. Do not assume the historical directory exists. Root fills only public pins and private file paths; no password values.
reviewed_bash_instructions.bash:
: "${SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_CA_FILE:?DBA-delivered public CA bundle path}"
: "${SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_LEAF_FILE:?DBA-delivered public leaf path}"
: "${SBK_MYSQL_CA_SHA256:?independently retained selected production CA file SHA256}"
: "${SBK_MYSQL_TLS_SERVER_NAME:?reviewed original Service DNS SAN}"
test "$(sha256sum -- "$SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_CA_FILE" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$SBK_MYSQL_CA_SHA256"
openssl x509 -in "$SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_LEAF_FILE" -noout \
  -subject -issuer -serial -dates -fingerprint -sha256 -ext subjectAltName
if [[ -n "${SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_INTERMEDIATE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
  openssl verify -CAfile "$SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_CA_FILE" \
    -untrusted "$SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_INTERMEDIATE_FILE" -purpose sslserver \
    -verify_hostname "$SBK_MYSQL_TLS_SERVER_NAME" "$SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_LEAF_FILE"
else
  openssl verify -CAfile "$SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_CA_FILE" -purpose sslserver \
    -verify_hostname "$SBK_MYSQL_TLS_SERVER_NAME" "$SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_LEAF_FILE"
fi
# Local certificate success is not proof of the running MySQL peer.

reviewed_bash_instructions.phase: Existing mysql client profiles only: source/installer/consumer identity and grants, no account creation
reviewed_bash_instructions.assumptions: Optional diagnostic for DBA/operator after profiles already exist. Each is a private mysql client option file, NOT a Go DSN or worker JSON credential. Root supplies paths only. Connect from the actual intended network source; operator-host success does not prove future Pod user@host matching. No profile creation, copying credentials or account alteration is included.
reviewed_bash_instructions.bash:
: "${SBK_MYSQL_TLS_SERVER_NAME:?selected Service DNS with verified SAN}"
: "${SBK_SOURCE_CLIENT_CNF:?existing private source mysql-client profile path}"
: "${SBK_INSTALLER_CLIENT_CNF:?existing private installer mysql-client profile path}"
: "${SBK_CONSUMER_CLIENT_CNF:?existing private consumer mysql-client profile path}"
for role in source installer consumer; do
  case "$role" in
    source) profile="$SBK_SOURCE_CLIENT_CNF";;
    installer) profile="$SBK_INSTALLER_CLIENT_CNF";;
    consumer) profile="$SBK_CONSUMER_CLIENT_CNF";;
  esac
  printf 'role=%s\n' "$role"
  stat -c 'mode=%a type=%F' -- "$profile"
  mysql --defaults-file="$profile" --protocol=TCP --host="$SBK_MYSQL_TLS_SERVER_NAME" --port=3306 \
    --ssl-mode=VERIFY_IDENTITY --ssl-ca="$SBK_PRODUCTION_MYSQL_CA_FILE" --tls-version=TLSv1.3 \
    --database=clawmanager --batch --raw \
    --execute="SELECT CURRENT_USER(),CURRENT_ROLE(),DATABASE(),@@server_uuid,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6); SHOW SESSION STATUS WHERE Variable_name IN ('Ssl_version','Ssl_cipher'); SHOW GRANTS FOR CURRENT_USER;"
done
# SHOW GRANTS is safe metadata on this MySQL8 target; no mysql.user authentication_string selection.
# Review exact current accounts/grants independently; do not use a successful DBA/root connection as their substitute.
